findings.dataCompleteness: All returned numeric metric fields non-null/non-empty in this snapshot; cohorts are incomplete and have different coverage. Missing player and missing row stay unavailable.
findings.pointPredictionLeakage: Existing same-season player_profile uses aggregate targets and outcomes covering held-out games. Current profile map overlaps 90 held-out players. Exclude from unbiased xFG estimation.
findings.eventEndpointClaimScope: No such endpoint in the inspected public China page bundle; no claim about all NBA official systems.
findings.validUse: Exact season-level retrieval, same-scope arithmetic comparisons, metric interpretation and evidence-scoped abstention; not per-event prediction features or labels.

currentLocalShots.note: Overlap describes joinability only; these full-season values are disallowed for held-out xFG estimation.

recommendations: Use shot/value as official target; expose neither value nor success/made nor outcome-dependent summary to prediction observations.
Keep existing grouped holdouts and build reference tables only from training rows; call time split only if every training row predates every relevant held-out event.
Add separate source-grounded retrieval task family for season gravity/leverage; held-out player prompts can retrieve source rows at evaluation without treating source context as secret labels.
Enforce metric identity, scope, period, sign, units and provenance in reward; do not give grounding credit merely because free text contains no invented number.
Use unavailable examples for event-level gravity/defense/leverage and known-absent players; score correct limitation, not made-up zeros.

latestUserScope.teamLabelSemantics: Team assignments reflect the logo/TEAMID labels in the current public season snapshots, not event-date membership or verified historical rosters.
